projects.title: SentimentScope: WhatsApp Sentiment Intelligence & Agentic RAG
projects.subtitle: Turning chaotic multi-language chat exports into structured sentiment intelligence and hallucination-free answers.
projects.challenge: WhatsApp is how millions of businesses in emerging markets communicate with customers, but messy multi-language chat histories make it impossible to track customer sentiment or answer business questions without hours of manual scrolling.
projects.solution: Built a production backend that routes queries through a four-tier architecture: deterministic lookups for simple questions, LLM-generated SQL for analytics, ChromaDB vector retrieval for conversational context, and grounded synthesis with strict source citations. Integrated a custom INT8 ONNX sentiment model running locally on CPU with Celery and Redis asynchronous workers.

beforeAfter.before: teams guessed customer sentiment or spent days combing through thousands of messages across English, Hausa, Yoruba, and Nigerian Pidgin.
beforeAfter.after: structured sentiment breakdown and citation-backed answers generated in seconds, with zero SQL injection risk and AST-validated queries.

results: 4-tier query routing reduces unnecessary LLM API calls and prevents hallucination
Local 384-dimensional embeddings and ChromaDB vector search for context retrieval
Sub-10ms sentiment inference measured on INT8 ONNX single-sample CPU execution without GPU dependency
Hardened with AST-level SQL validation, tenant isolation, and token-by-token SSE streaming

projects.title: Joule Dynamics: Agentic Real Estate Market Intelligence
projects.subtitle: Translating natural real estate questions into automated database queries, pricing alerts, and market benchmarks.
projects.challenge: Short-term rental managers lose bookings when competitors drop rates quietly. Checking listings by hand across multiple cities is exhausting and outdated by the time pricing decisions are made.
projects.solution: An agentic backend with an 18-tool orchestration framework that translates plain English queries into parameterized PostgreSQL and pgvector operations. Uses local embeddings to dynamically select only the relevant tools per query, shrinking prompt token overhead by more than 75% while keeping multi-step reasoning intact.

beforeAfter.before: property managers spent hours cross-referencing Airbnb prices across spreadsheets and reacted days late to market price drops.
beforeAfter.after: multi-market rate tracking updated 4 times daily, with automated 25% spike anomaly detection and conversational intelligence.

results: 18 specialized tools covering geospatial search, volatility baselines, and CMA generation
Dynamic tool discovery cuts prompt tokens by over 75% compared to injecting all 18 tool schemas per query
Full telemetry observability with Langfuse and OpenTelemetry tracking token spend and latency
Live pilot monitoring 65+ listings across New York, Miami, Lagos, and Abuja with 25% price spike alerts against rolling 7-day baselines

projects.title: Homa (Afrique-Gemma-4B): Multilingual Agricultural LLM
projects.subtitle: Supervised fine-tuning of a 4B parameter model for Nigerian farmers across four indigenous languages.
projects.challenge: Smallholder farmers across Nigeria need timely guidance on crops, soil management, and livestock, but general-purpose LLMs lack localized agricultural knowledge and fail when spoken to in indigenous languages.
projects.solution: Led the fine-tuning pipeline for Homa as part of the Fallback AI team, adapting McGill-NLP/AfriqueGemma-4B using LoRA across attention and MLP layers. Trained on 5,500+ curated instruction-response pairs in English, Hausa, Igbo, and Yoruba, then merged weights and quantized to GGUF Q4_K_M for offline edge inference.

beforeAfter.before: extension workers had to travel physically to remote farms, while existing AI tools failed on regional terminology and crop diseases.
beforeAfter.after: a lightweight, quantized 4B model capable of running locally on modest hardware with explicit agricultural safety boundaries.

results: 5,500+ language-balanced instruction pairs covering crop management and livestock health
Evaluated on held-out test sets with 71.5% token prediction accuracy
Merged and quantized to GGUF Q4_K_M for offline execution via llama.cpp and Ollama
Built-in out-of-domain guardrails to refuse unsafe medical or non-farming queries

projects.title: AfroXLMR-mini: Nigerian Multilingual Sentiment Model
projects.subtitle: End-to-end transformer fine-tuning and INT8 quantization for sub-10ms CPU inference.
projects.challenge: Off-the-shelf sentiment models crumble when processing West African text because people blend English with Nigerian Pidgin, Hausa, Yoruba, and Igbo in everyday conversations.
projects.solution: Designed a two-stage transfer learning pipeline starting from Davlan/afro-xlmr-mini. Pre-trained across 140,256 multilingual samples, followed by domain adaptation on 1,058 anonymized WhatsApp chat messages. Optimized the PyTorch model into INT8 ONNX for cost-effective CPU serving.

beforeAfter.before: sentiment classification accuracy on Nigerian Pidgin sat below 60% with heavy cloud GPU hosting bills.
beforeAfter.after: 94.29% accuracy and 94.13% Macro F1 on WhatsApp chats, running in 8.2ms on basic CPU instances.

results: 140,256 training samples spanning 5 regional languages
94.29% accuracy and 96.25% Macro F1 on Nigerian Pidgin test splits
Storage reduced from 469.9 MB to 112.9 MB (76% reduction) via dynamic INT8 quantization
Single-sample CPU inference latency dropped from 42ms to 8.2ms

projects.title: Google Gemini RAG: Multi-Modal Document Intelligence
projects.subtitle: Accurate Q&A over complex PDF manuals, technical drawings, and data tables with source citations.
projects.challenge: Real-world engineering documents and technical reports pack crucial data into charts, schematics, and multi-column tables that basic text extractors mangle into gibberish.
projects.solution: Developed a specialized RAG pipeline that pairs Google Gemini with FAISS vector indexing. Extracts and chunks content from text, tables, and images within PDFs, applying fuzzy document matching, duplicate detection, and explicit source attribution with confidence scoring.

beforeAfter.before: analysts had to manually scan 100-page operational manuals and risk missing vital figures tucked inside diagrams.
beforeAfter.after: instant document retrieval with exact page citations and confidence scores, cutting verification time down to seconds.

results: Multi-modal chunking capable of extracting tables, visual diagrams, and dense text
FAISS vector indexing with persistent storage for rapid local retrieval
Strict citation and attribution rules to suppress hallucination
Fuzzy matching engine to handle misspelled queries and document titles

projects.title: Nexus: Distributed Technical Audit Crawler & MCP Query Engine
projects.subtitle: High-throughput distributed crawling paired with Model Context Protocol tools for AI agents.
projects.challenge: Deep technical website audits require crawling thousands of dynamic pages without getting blocked, while giving AI agents a clean way to inspect audit findings programmatically.
projects.solution: Architected a distributed web audit system using Redis Streams and consumer groups. It features a dual-engine crawler that starts with lightweight HTTP fetching and escalates to headless Playwright browsers only for JavaScript-heavy pages. Exposes an MCP adapter with 6 tools so AI agents can trigger audits and query findings.

beforeAfter.before: audits were slow, crashed on dynamic sites, and produced static spreadsheets that AI assistants could not interact with.
beforeAfter.after: fault-tolerant distributed crawling with dead-letter recovery and native MCP tools for autonomous AI agents.

results: 6-tool Model Context Protocol (MCP) adapter enabling AI agents to conduct site audits
Dual-engine architecture with automatic escalation to headless browser execution
Redis Streams coordination with token-bucket rate limiting and stale-task reclamation
106 automated tests ensuring zero crawl state corruption or worker dropouts

projects.title: Autonomous Price Monitor & B2B Lead Generator
projects.subtitle: Cost-efficient tiered extraction combining deterministic scraping with LLM fallback across three specialized engines.
projects.challenge: Web scraping pipelines break whenever websites update their layout. Sending every scraped page to an LLM for parsing fixes the breakage, but it explodes API bills.
projects.solution: Built a unified background scraping engine with three autonomous workers: e-commerce price monitoring, real estate rate tracking, and B2B lead generation. Relies on StealthyFetcher with curl_cffi and Scrapling for anti-bot bypass, using fast Tier-1 regex and DOM extraction first, with automated Groq and LLaMA-3 fallback only when layouts mutate.

beforeAfter.before: scrapers broke weekly requiring manual code fixes, or cost hundreds of dollars in unnecessary LLM token fees.
beforeAfter.after: fully autonomous daily runs via GitHub Actions that repair themselves when websites change, keeping token costs near zero.

results: Tiered extraction saves over 90% in token spend by reserving LLMs for structural fallbacks
Three distinct engines: retail price tracking, booking rate monitoring, and B2B prospecting
Stealthy HTTP fetching using curl_cffi and Scrapling to evade bot detection
Serverless cron execution powered by scheduled GitHub Actions workflows writing to PostgreSQL

projects.title: VectorGallery: Multimodal CLIP Embeddings & Vector Search
projects.subtitle: Semantic image discovery and similarity retrieval integrated into live e-commerce.
projects.challenge: Traditional keyword search on e-commerce sites fails when shoppers describe visual styles (such as vintage denim jacket with brass buttons) instead of typing exact catalog titles.
projects.solution: Built at Zibeh Institute of Technology and integrated into a live retail store in partnership with their engineering team. Converts product imagery and text queries into 512-dimensional multimodal CLIP vectors, indexed with HNSW for sub-second visual similarity search.

beforeAfter.before: shoppers got zero results if their search terms did not match exact product names or tags.
beforeAfter.after: natural language visual search and image-to-image similarity that lifted search retrieval speed by 85%.

results: 512-dimensional multimodal CLIP embeddings for text-to-image and image-to-image retrieval
HNSW vector indexing delivering sub-second similarity matching across catalog items
Dual persistence model with JSONL ground truth to prevent index desynchronization
Directly integrated into a live production store catalog

projects.title: N-HIP: Nigeria Humanitarian Intelligence Platform
projects.subtitle: Automated ETL and spatial data engineering for crisis response and resource allocation across Nigeria.
projects.challenge: Humanitarian response teams in Nigeria frequently work with fragmented reports from NGOs and government agencies, making it hard to see where aid is urgently needed during crises.
projects.solution: Automated end-to-end data pipeline extracting humanitarian indicators from the United Nations OCHA Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX HAPI v2). Enforces Pydantic validation, aligns PostGIS boundaries across all 37 States and 774 Local Government Areas, stores relational facts in Supabase PostgreSQL, and serves interactive SQL data marts to a live Power BI Service report.

beforeAfter.before: relief coordinators manually stitched inconsistent spreadsheets together, slowing down critical field decisions.
beforeAfter.after: automated daily pipeline delivering clean, geographically grounded operational intelligence to field leaders via live cloud dashboards.

results: Live interactive Power BI Service report with demographic and cluster vulnerability heatmaps
Automated daily ETL pipeline extracting from UN OCHA HDX HAPI v2 via GitHub Actions
Spatial data normalization using PostGIS across all 37 States and 774 Nigerian LGAs
Pydantic data contract validation preventing malformed or duplicated crisis records

projects.title: Smart Assistive Wheelchair: Microcontroller Sensor Fusion & Edge Obstacle Avoidance
projects.subtitle: Multi-sensor collision avoidance, embedded firmware, and physical chassis engineering for mobility assistance.
projects.challenge: Mobility-impaired individuals face high risks of collisions and steep costs for imported assistive equipment, lacking localized solutions tailored to rugged terrain and everyday obstacles.
projects.solution: Engineered a powered smart wheelchair integrating ultrasonic distance arrays, infrared proximity sensors, and an embedded microcontroller. Authored deterministic C++ firmware for real-time obstacle avoidance with sub-50ms reaction times, paired with a custom welded steel chassis and dual high-torque DC motor drive.

beforeAfter.before: fragile imported wheelchairs cost thousands of dollars with zero collision awareness, causing frequent accidents in tight corridors.
beforeAfter.after: a durable, locally fabricated chassis with autonomous obstacle sensing and automatic emergency braking.

results: Multi-sensor array delivering sub-50ms obstacle detection and automatic deceleration
Custom welded steel chassis designed and load-tested for up to 100kg passenger weight
Dual high-torque 12V DC motor drive powered by an H-bridge PWM motor controller
Complete mechanical engineering documentation including stress analysis and wiring schematics
